effect_description_eng: [Main] Trash 2 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, if you have a Tamer with [Joe Kido] in its name, choose 1 of your Digimon. If your opponent has no Digimon with as many or more digivolution cards as that Digimon, unsuspend it.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects. Then, add this card to your hand.
